name: Ophelia
source:
She is Dr.[url=https://vndb.org/c72226]Bolonious[/url]'s only daughter, and the Zombie Seed. 

[spoiler]She was in love with her father, and wanted to forever bring those forbidden feelings with her to her death from her father [url=https://vndb.org/c72226]Bolonious [/url] when she died of an incurable illness. [/spoiler]

[spoiler]Her dead body was used and awakened to insanity as a powerful zombie by Snake Crest to further their plans. [/spoiler]
